name: ecc-unity
description: A curated ECC adaptation for Relic Keeper: Unity 6 research, planning, NUnit testing, review, verification, and the existing Unity Bridge CLI.

interface.longDescription: Six focused skills for Relic Keeper's Unity 6.3 2D action RPG. Uses the existing Unity Bridge CLI and pixel UI skill. Skills only: no bundled hooks, MCP servers, model overrides, or automatic learning.
defaultPrompt: Use $ecc-unity-plan to plan this Relic Keeper feature.
Use $ecc-unity-review to review this Unity change.
Use $ecc-unity-verify to validate this change with Unity Bridge.
